title: DR reflection plan: api layer (6 of 64 relationship changes)
rationale: Relationship schemas in the api layer that the maintainer-note triage and the sorting-question reflection (cli/scripts/spec-enrich) want removed, renamed, reversed or retargeted. Each operation carries the claims and Clef's sorting answers as evidence and the plan's probability. Accepting an operation means DR applies it with apply-walk.ts; rejecting means the schema stays.

operations.rationale: Remove api.mediatype.aggregates.api.encoding: api.mediatype.composes.api.encoding already exists and expresses it. Plan kind remove-duplicate, p 0.78; claims rel:api.mediatype#1.

evidence.quote: api.mediatype has both aggregates and composes relationships to api.encoding, which are contradictory because Encoding cannot exist outside its MediaType, so only composes should remain. Proposed: Remove the api.mediatype aggregates api.encoding relationship and keep composes.

Sorting answers (rel:api.mediatype#1): best source of 'aggregates api.encoding': none (0.39), api.encoding (0.31), api.mediatype (0.20); best destination of 'api.mediatype aggregates': api.encoding (0.61), none (0.29), api.components (0.03); best predicate: composes (0.78), aggregates (0.06), uses (0.04). Outcome: alternative (predicate=composes).

operations.rationale: Rename the predicate of api.parameter.references.api.schema to api.parameter.uses.api.schema. Plan kind rename-predicate, p 0.35; claims rel:api.parameter#3.

evidence.quote: The relationship api.parameter references api.schema would be more precise with a constrained-by predicate than references. Proposed: Change the predicate of parameter→schema from references to constrained-by.

Sorting answers (rel:api.parameter#3): best source of 'references api.schema': api.parameter (0.86), api.mediatype (0.04), api.operation (0.03); best destination of 'api.parameter references': api.schema (0.81), none (0.06), api.components (0.04); best predicate: uses (0.35), references (0.18), depends-on (0.18). Outcome: alternative (predicate=uses).

operations.rationale: Rename the predicate of api.operation.delivers.api.response to api.operation.aggregates.api.response. Plan kind rename-predicate, p 0.22; claims rel:api.operation#4.

evidence.quote: The relationship api.operation delivers api.response duplicates api.operation composes api.responses. Proposed: Remove one of the two relationships.

Sorting answers (rel:api.operation#4): best source of 'delivers api.response': api.operation (0.68), none (0.16), api.components (0.08); best destination of 'api.operation delivers': api.response (0.53), none (0.26), api.components (0.05); best predicate: aggregates (0.22), composes (0.21), none (0.17). Outcome: alternative (predicate=aggregates).

operations.rationale: Retarget of api.mediatype.associated-with.api.header to api.encoding.associated-with.api.header. Plan kind retarget, p 0.66; claims rel:api.mediatype#2.

evidence.quote: The associated-with relationship from api.mediatype to api.header is indirect (it goes via Encoding) and therefore redundant. Proposed: Remove the api.mediatype associated-with api.header relationship.

Sorting answers (rel:api.mediatype#2): best source of 'associated-with api.header': api.encoding (0.66), none (0.19), api.mediatype (0.09); best destination of 'api.mediatype associated-with': none (0.55), api.encoding (0.34), api.header (0.04); best predicate: none (0.75), associated-with (0.12), aggregates (0.04). Outcome: alternative (source=api.encoding).

operations.rationale: Change of api.components.composes.api.response to api.components.aggregates.api.response. Claims disagree on the replacement (api.components.aggregates.api.response | api.responses.aggregates.api.response); the first is proposed, the others are in dr.replacement for a re-proposal if this one is rejected. Plan kind conflict, p 0.88; claims node:api.components#3, rel:api.components#1.

evidence.quote: api.response is related to api.components by both an aggregates and a composes relationship, which express the same meaning redundantly. Proposed: Keep only one of aggregates or composes between api.components and api.response.

api.components has both an aggregates and a composes relationship to api.response, which are redundant and contradictory. Proposed: Keep a single relationship from api.components to api.response and remove the other.

Sorting answers (node:api.components#3): best source of 'composes api.response': api.components (0.34), api.responses (0.30), none (0.26); best destination of 'api.components composes': none (0.51), api.response (0.29), api.responses (0.06); best predicate: aggregates (0.88), composes (0.05), none (0.03). Outcome: alternative (predicate=aggregates).

Sorting answers (rel:api.components#1): best source of 'composes api.response': api.responses (0.44), api.components (0.27), none (0.18); best destination of 'api.components composes': api.response (0.38), api.header (0.20), none (0.14); best predicate: aggregates (0.84), none (0.06), composes (0.05). Outcome: alternative (source=api.responses; predicate=aggregates).

operations.rationale: Change of api.operation.composes.api.paths to api.paths.serves.api.operation. Claims disagree on the replacement (api.paths.serves.api.operation | api.paths.serves.api.openapidocument | api.responses.serves.api.openapidocument); the first is proposed, the others are in dr.replacement for a re-proposal if this one is rejected. Plan kind conflict, p 0.47; claims node:api.operation#5, node:api.paths#3, rel:api.operation#1.

evidence.quote: The outgoing 'composes api.paths' relationship from api.operation is inverted, since Paths composes operations (via PathItem) rather than the reverse. Proposed: Reverse the edge or remove it so that paths/pathitem composes operation.

The relationship 'api.operation composes api.paths' inverts containment, since paths contain operations via path items. Proposed: Remove or reverse the relationship so containment does not run from api.operation to api.paths.

The relationship api.operation composes api.paths is inverted, because Paths contains PathItems which contain operations. Proposed: Remove or reverse it so that api.paths (via api.pathitem) composes api.operation.

Sorting answers (node:api.operation#5): best source of 'composes api.paths': none (0.57), api.openapidocument (0.25), api.operation (0.08); best destination of 'api.operation composes': none (0.62), api.paths (0.30), api.responses (0.02); best predicate: reverse:serves (0.30), none (0.29), composes (0.08). Outcome: alternative (predicate=reverse:serves).

Sorting answers (node:api.paths#3): best source of 'composes api.paths': api.openapidocument (0.46), none (0.38), api.operation (0.08); best destination of 'api.operation composes': none (0.71), api.paths (0.16), api.responses (0.05); best predicate: reverse:serves (0.37), none (0.27), composes (0.06). Outcome: alternative (source=api.openapidocument; predicate=reverse:serves).

Sorting answers (rel:api.operation#1): best source of 'composes api.paths': api.openapidocument (0.62), none (0.28), api.operation (0.03); best destination of 'api.operation composes': api.responses (0.47), none (0.28), api.paths (0.15); best predicate: reverse:serves (0.51), none (0.27), uses (0.04). Outcome: alternative (source=api.openapidocument; target=api.responses; predicate=reverse:serves).
